subject: OpenMSD kickoff - the multilingual science corpus, at full scale
body:
Team,

Kicking off the OpenMSD build. Retrieval and science-QA teams keep asking for a multilingual scientific corpus with real citation structure, and our open-source OpenMSD release is exactly that: papers joined across OpenCitations, CrossRef metadata, and full-text sources, producing citation, co-citation, and bibliographic-couple pairs. The quick-start path (run.sh producing example papers and citation relations) is verified on Python 3.10.9; now we do the full-scale build.

Be clear-eyed about the input sizes: the extracted COCI CSVs alone are ~240 GB and the CrossRef metadata dump is another ~185 GB of json.gz, before any processing. This is a storage-and-pipeline project more than a modeling one.

Milestones: raw sources landed and validated by April 10; full join + relation extraction by May 8; corpus handed to Corpus platform with a datasheet by May 29.

Bruno - staffing, storage ask, and the Corpus coordination plan please.

Dmitri
